response.text:
I can’t keep checking your calendar in the background or “keep doing it after this response.” I don’t have any automation or reminder tool that lets me run continuously or push messages by itself. I can only act when you ask me in a turn or when we create an automation using a supported connector (which isn’t available here).

Options I can do now (choose one):

1) Create a daily recurring calendar reminder (I can use the calendar connector to create a recurring event on your calendar at a time you choose). That will put a visible reminder on your calendar each morning so you’ll see it and can ask me to check when you want. I can include text in the event like “Check for moved events and message the assistant if any moved.” This is reversible and I’ll ask confirmation before creating it.

2) Do on-demand checks: each morning you send a quick message like “Check my calendar now” (or I can give you a short phrase to send). When you do that I will inspect your calendar that turn and report any moved events.

3) If you want fully automatic monitoring/notifications, you’ll need to enable a separate automation/service (webhook, calendar-watch integration, or third-party automation tool). I can describe how to set that up or draft instructions for IT.

If you want option 1 (create a daily reminder), tell me:
- Time of day (e.g., 8:00 AM)
- Time zone
- Start date (or “today”)
- Title you want for the reminder (or I can use: “Check calendar for moved events”)
- Whether to make it an all-day event or at a specific time
- Any description you want in the event
- Whether to create it as a single event or a recurring series

If you want option 2, tell me the exact phrase you’ll use each morning (or I can suggest one). If you want instructions for option 3, say so and I’ll outline the approach.

Which do you want me to do?
